main_text.l: mus Carmelitarum magister generalis, deforma-tum sui ordinis statum piis lachrymis deplorabat, quod a pristina morum probitate ac sanctis stu-diis, sui fratres tunc essent in omnium vitiorum la-byrinthum prolapsi. Prius enim dum eremos inco-lerent, orationi, lectioni, ac manuum labori iugi-ter incumbebant. Tunc autem in urbibus commo-rantes, sub hypocrisi matre, omnia in ocium, desi-diam, inertiam, libidinem & luxum convertebant.

Is igitur post quinq; sui regiminis annos, laboris in utiliter expensi tædio tædus, officio cessit: & edi-to in eos libro satis aculeato (igneam sagittam uo-cabat) ad eremi quietem, illis relictis, est reversus in montem Euuatrof, anno Domini 1270. Qui post quam privignos, reprobos, cauteriatos errones, fibulatores, garrulos, inutiles consiliarios, mali-gnos discurfores, Sodomæ cives, optimi testamen-ti contemptores, præsentium & futurorum sedu-ctores, Draconis caudam tertiam stellarum par-tem de cælo trahentem & in terram mittentem,

& his similia vocasset, in hæc veiba[?] in quinto capite prorupit: Dicite (inquit) quæ & quæ lis est ista religio nova, in civitatibus adinventa? Per plateas civitatum, de mane usq; adversperam bini & bini discurrentes, vagis gres bus circuitis, ipsum habentes pædagogum, qui rugiendo circuit

page.notes: Underlining in the text ("Tunc autem in urbibus commorantes", "Qui post", "Dicite(inquit) quæ & quæ") is emphasis only and is not transcribed as markup. "tædus" in the line "tædio tædus" is printed as "tastus" in the scan. The word after "veiba" is doubtful. The printed "ueiba" is probably a misprint for "verba" and is kept as read, with [?]. "gres bus" is printed with a space. Signature "m 3" and catchword "quæ" are at the foot. Paragraph break after "convertebant." is taken from the short line ending.
